draft.emotion: warm and respectful, speaking of a beloved family member
notes: Plural: آبَاء (ʔābāʔ). The dual أَبَوَان (ʔabawān) means 'parents'.
One of the 'five nouns' (الأَسْمَاء الخَمْسَة): takes long-vowel case endings before a noun or suffix (أَبُو / أَبَا / أَبِي), except with 'my': أَبِي (ʔabī, 'my father').

faults.why: Lacks the irregular long-vowel inflection in construct/pronoun forms (أبو / أبا / أبي) and the broken plural (آباء).
Singular أَب means 'father', not gender-neutral 'parent' (though dual أَبَوَان means 'parents').
